name: Super Reaper 6000
summary: At Windshear Crag, Ziz Fizziks seeks favor with his new boss, Sputtervalve. He wants the Venture Company’s plans for a great woodcutting machine designed by his rival, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle.

sections.title: Industrial Espionage in Windshear Crag
sections.body: At Windshear Crag, the Venture Trading Company cuts deep into the Stonetalon Mountains to feed its logging operation. Ziz Fizziks, a goblin engineer recently cast out of the company, now works for Sputtervalve. He hopes to prove his worth to his new boss by taking the plans for the company’s massive automated woodcutting machine, the Super Reaper 6000.

sections.title: Goblins vs. Gnomish Engineering
sections.body: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s appointment as the Venture Company’s local engineering lead rankles Ziz. The company is mostly goblin-run, yet it put a gnome in charge of its engineering. When the Venture Company machine operators’ schematics reach Ziz, their intricate design leaves him frustrated. He is used to brute force, cheap parts, and volatile combustion, and finds Gerenzo’s careful plans hard to understand.

faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks is a goblin engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Venture Company recently fired him, and Sputtervalve soon hired him. Now Ziz seeks payback against his former employers.
The Super Reaper 6000 is a huge mechanical woodcutting machine designed for the Venture Company’s logging operation at Windshear Crag.
Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a gnome tinkerer hired by the Venture Company, designed the Super Reaper 6000. His appointment deeply offends the goblin engineers who once ran the site.

faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve want the blueprints?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve wants the Venture Company’s heavy logging technology. Ziz hopes to bring him the plans and prove his usefulness to his new employer.

aliases: where do i find the plans
faq.answer: Venture Company machine operators carry the schematics as they supervise the harvesting machinery in Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Why does Ziz struggle to read the blueprints once retrieved?
aliases: why cant ziz read the plans
faq.answer: Ziz struggles with the plans because goblin and gnomish engineering philosophies differ. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s meticulous diagrams are too confusing for Ziz to decipher at a glance.

angles.text: Goblin engineering favors speed and rough pragmatism; gnomish design prizes precision and complexity. Their rivalry runs deep.
As a gnome, you may recognize why Ziz doubts that a goblin syndicate would trust one of your kind with its flagship machinery. Gerenzo’s technical designs leave him baffled.
As a night elf, you see the Super Reaper 6000 cutting ancient trees in Stonetalon to feed industrial profit, a stark sign of mortal disregard for nature.
